title: Student Grade Manager reference implementation notes
architecture_notes: Keep student grade manager separated into domain types, business logic, input/output or adapters, configuration, and tests. The final implementation should satisfy the project rubric rather than copying a fixed listing.
review_checklist: Build with the documented JDK and dependency lock/wrapper where applicable.
Run all automated tests from a clean checkout.
Exercise invalid input and failure paths.
Confirm that secrets, credentials, and learner data are not committed or logged.
Review the acceptance rubric before publishing.
limitation: This is a protected solution-design brief, not a complete tested implementation.
